abstract: Laparoscopy is the standard method for the diagnosis and treatment of ovarian dermoid cysts, which represent 10% to 15% of all ovarian tumors. This procedure offers many advantages including less postoperative pain, lower risk of wound complication, early ambulation, and more rapid convalescence. The risk of adhesion formation also is reduced. However, in the case of an ovarian dermoid cyst, the laparoscopic approach could result in chemical peritonitis caused by the spilled contents of a ruptured dermoid cyst. We report a case of chemical peritonitis after rupture of an ovarian dermoid cyst during laparoscopy. Two operations were required, and medical treatment was not beneficial. We discuss a possible new medication for the treatment of this complication and compare this case with other recent reports.
abstract_ja: 腹腔鏡検査は卵巣類皮嚢腫の診断と治療の標準的な方法であり、卵巣腫瘍の10~15%を占めます。本法には、術後疼痛の軽減、創部合併症のリスク低下、早期離床、より迅速な回復などの利点があります。また癒着形成のリスクも低下します。しかし卵巣類皮嚢腫の場合、腹腔鏡手術により破裂した嚢腫の内容物が漏出し、化学性腹膜炎を生じるおそれがあります。われわれは腹腔鏡手術中に卵巣類皮嚢腫が破裂し、化学性腹膜炎を生じた症例を報告します。2回の手術を要し、薬物療法は有効ではありませんでした。この合併症に対する新たな治療薬の可能性を考察し、本例を最近の報告と比較します。
